description: Template (Ticket c7db227d Punkt 12) for the scheduled agent 'Vertragsablage überwachen': returns ready-to-use provision_agent arguments (server_job, every 15 minutes, 07–19 h, Mon–Fri) whose run is: scan_contract_folder → import_contract_from_folder ONLY for bundles with bereits_erfasst=false (asynchronous; poll get_contract_import) → uncertain results (zu_pruefen / unsichere_felder / uebersprungene_dateien) become ONE todo per contract — plus the set_contract_scan_rules call that stores the DAILY AI COST LIMIT (max_imports_per_day: each import is one AI extraction; import_contract_from_folder refuses further imports that day once reached). Creates NOTHING itself: review, then call provision_agent and set_contract_scan_rules with the returned arguments. Required: bridge, folder. Optional: path, our_names, max_imports_per_day (default 20), name (default 'Vertragsablage überwachen').

bridge.description: Bridge slug of the connected computer to monitor

folder.description: Allowed folder of that bridge to monitor

max_imports_per_day.description: Daily cap on imports for the cost limit (default 20)

name.description: Name of the agent (default Vertragsablage ueberwachen)

our_names.description: How we appear in contracts (decides our role)

name: contract_folder_agent_template
